dedupe_keys.name: knowledge base of nature based solutions for water treatment and stormwater management icra

description: This knowledge base catalogues nature-based solutions for wastewater treatment and stormwater management and the scientific evidence behind them. It holds five tables: a catalogue of 54 solutions giving for each its pollutant removal performance, suitable water types (from raw domestic wastewater and greywater to combined sewer overflow and runoff), land area per person by climate, hydraulic loading, ecosystem services and co-benefits, barriers and capital and operating costs; a list of scientific publications on these technologies (about 500 rows); treatment performance details extracted from the publications; and descriptor tables for the catalogue and the treatment data. It covers solutions applicable worldwide, with land needs for tropical, dry, temperate and continental climates. It was compiled by Josep Pueyo-Ros, Joaquim Comas and Vicenç Acuña at ICRA in the EU-funded MULTISOURCE project; version 2.0 was published on Zenodo on 3 October 2024 under CC BY 4.0 as semicolon-separated CSV files with a README, and the latest tables can be queried from the SNAPP API. Caveats: values are ranges from literature, not measurements at one site, and the catalogue is limited to the technologies the project reviewed. It supports sizing and screening of green-blue infrastructure in climate adaptation and water planning models; a related record is the Nat4Wat selection tool, which it powers.
